mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stock_plate ( plate_name, data_source, last_seen_trade_date, active ) VALUES
( #{item.plateName}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.lastSeenTradeDate}, 1 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_seen_trade_date = VALUES(last_seen_trade_date), active = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, plate_name, data_source, last_seen_trade_date, active, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_plate WHERE data_source = #{dataSource} ORDER BY plate_name
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stock_plate_member ( plate_id, stock_code, last_seen_trade_date, active ) VALUES
( #{item.plateId}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.lastSeenTradeDate}, 1 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_seen_trade_date = VALUES(last_seen_trade_date), active = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_plate_member member INNER JOIN stock_plate plate ON plate.id = member.plate_id SET member.active = 0, member.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plate.data_source = #{dataSource} AND member.last_seen_trade_date < #{tradeDate} AND member.active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_plate_member member INNER JOIN stock_plate plate ON plate.id = member.plate_id WHERE plate.data_source = #{dataSource} AND member.last_seen_trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND member.active = 1 AND plate.active = 1

SELECT plate.id AS plate_id, plate.plate_name, member.stock_code FROM stock_plate plate INNER JOIN stock_plate_member member ON member.plate_id = plate.id WHERE plate.data_source = #{dataSource} AND plate.active = 1 AND member.active = 1 ORDER BY plate.plate_name, member.stock_code
